text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 502/5xx rate in canary for model redwood-gen-v3, signature includes tokenizer errors and weight checksum mismatch. Paging oncall.

oncall-sre: acknowledge, joining. Pulling canary logs and recent deploys.

kevin-release: I kicked a canary promote at 11:58. Artifact tag `redwood-gen-v3:2026-03-17-cutover`. Did a follow-up weight swap at 11:59. Not sure if the tokenizer build finished before weights were promoted.

eva.ml: logs from prod-canary-3 show tokenizer errors + mismatched logits:
```
2026-03-17T11:59:34Z ERROR tokenizer: unknown token id 65536 -> �
2026-03-17T11:59:34Z ERROR model: weightset checksum mismatch expected sha256:fa1e.. got sha256:71b2..
```

maria-support: Customer impact: 18 new tickets referencing gibberish output and service errors in the last 8 minutes. Two enterprise accounts opened priority incidents.

oncall-sre: Immediate mitigation plan: (1) flip canary routing flag to fallback stable variant, (2) pause rollout pipeline, (3) start rollback of canary weightset. What is the feature flag name for routing?

kevin-release: The flag is `release.routing.v3.canary_override`. Flipping now to `stable-2026-03-01`.

deploy-bot: Running:
```
redwoodctl flags set release.routing.v3.canary_override=stable-2026-03-01 --env=prod-canary
```
deploy-bot: OK — flag updated across canary edges.

oncall-sre: Diverted canary traffic. Observing metrics.

incident-bot: Canary 5xx spike reduced to baseline within ~90s after diversion.

eva.ml: Confirmed: tokenizer errors disappear on nodes routed to stable variant. Nodes still on the cutover weightset show checksum mismatch.

kevin-release: Initiating quick rollback of the canary artifact to prevent any auto-promote from the pipeline:
```
releasectl rollback --model redwood-gen-v3 --from 2026-03-17-cutover --to stable-2026-03-01
```

releasectl: rollback orchestration started -> swapping weight references in canary pool -> validating post-swap.

releasectl: rollback complete for canary.

kevin-release: Rollback done. Pausing the main rollout job and gating promotions until we validate the pipeline.

maria-support: Sent holding notice to the two enterprise customers. Short update saying we mitigated and are investigating root cause, will follow up with a detailed report.

oncall-sre: Incident summary for handoff:
- Symptom: canary 5xx/gibberish
- Cause (initial): promoted weightset did not match tokenizer artifact (checksum mismatch / race in release pipeline)
- Mitigation: flipped `release.routing.v3.canary_override` to stable, rolled back canary, paused rollout
- Impact: 18 user tickets, 2 enterprise customers impacted, no data exfiltration
- Current status: canary healthy for 10m, no new tokenization errors
- Next steps: add pre-promote checksum gating, add E2E tokenizer+decode smoke test in release pipeline, add auto-revert on post-promote checksum mismatch

eva.ml: Root cause hypothesis: async promotion step copied weights before tokenizer packaging finished; manifest hash not enforced. I'll add a manifest/hash verification stage and make the promote step dependent on tokenizer artifact completion.

kevin-release: I'll add a stop-gap: fail promote if recorded weightset SHA != declared manifest SHA, and add a CI job that simulates a promote race.

maria-support: Preparing a customer post-incident email draft; will include mitigation details and planned preventative actions. Asking legal for review.

oncall-sre: Assigning action owners: @kevin-release (block rollout + add gating), @eva.ml (add manifest validation), @maria-support (customer comms), SRE (monitor canary for 24h). Handoff to @kevin-release for monitoring — I'm available on pager escalation.

kevin-release: Thanks — monitoring checks every 5m for 1h, will escalate if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident marked sev2 -> mitigated. Please open postmortem ticket: PM-INC-612345 and attach deploy logs and releasectl trace.

oncall-sre: Good work. Please ensure the release pipeline adds a blocking check that compares the tokenizer-artifact-sha256 against the weightset manifest before any promote action. Closing thread for now, will reopen if metrics regress.
